replacementText.description: Exact replacement passage, preserving required LaTeX and without extra commentary.

summary.description: Concise description of the proposed change.

relatedChanges.description: Optional synchronized manuscript changes in other .tex files. Use an empty array when the selected passage is the only required change.

path.description: Repository-relative path under the configured manuscript source root, ending in .tex.

selectedText.description: Exact, uniquely occurring source text to replace in the related file.

replacementText.description: Exact replacement for selectedText in the related file.

reason.description: Why this related change is needed for manuscript consistency.

required.description: True when applying the primary change without this change would leave the manuscript inconsistent.
